findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: run_planar_filter, design_patch_antenna, compare_rf_chains · Private data: run_planar_filter, lookup_component_by_mpn, find_components_by_spec, run_sparam_cascade · Public sink: run_ota_link, run_radar_performance, run_planar_filter, design_patch_antenna, run_glass_weave_analysis, compare_rf_chains · Destructive: run_link_budget, run_stackup_solver, run_thermal_analysis, run_pdn_analysis, run_compliance_analysis, run_ota_link, run_radar_performance, run_planar_filter, run_glass_weave_analysis, run_sparam_cascade, check_grounding.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: run_planar_filter, design_patch_antenna, compare_rf_chains · Private data: run_planar_filter, lookup_component_by_mpn, find_components_by_spec, run_sparam_cascade · Public sink: run_ota_link, run_radar_performance, run_planar_filter, design_patch_antenna, run_glass_weave_analysis, compare_rf_chains · Destructive: run_link_budget, run_stackup_solver, run_thermal_analysis, run_pdn_analysis, run_compliance_analysis, run_ota_link, run_radar_performance, run_planar_filter, run_glass_weave_analysis, run_sparam_cascade, check_grounding

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "run_thermal_analysis" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "PCB thermal analysis: via array Rth, junction-to-ambient stack, Kennedy spreading, Coffin-Manson barrel stress, Timoshenko warpage, and resin-flow estimation. Call with no arguments once a design exists: the server takes power_w from the designed chain's dissipated power and defaults ambient_c to 25" → after: "PCB thermal analysis: via array Rth, junction-to-ambient stack, pour fin spreading, Coffin-Manson barrel stress, Timoshenko warpage, and resin-flow estimation. Call with no arguments once a design exists: the server takes power_w from the designed chain's dissipated power and defaults ambient_c to 2"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
